prompt: Who was the most recent Sheriff of Los Angeles County killed in the line of duty?
answer:
The most recent **Los Angeles County sheriff to be killed in the line of duty was Sheriff William “Billy” C. Getman**, who was shot and killed on **January 7, 1858**, while confronting an armed man in Los Angeles.

This refers specifically to someone holding the rank of **sheriff**; several LASD deputies and detectives have died in the line of duty since then, most recently three detectives killed in the 2025 Biscailuz Training Center explosion.
